Suddenly, you bump your head on the ceiling, but it's not such a bad bump that it's going to prevent you from looking at objects and even things. There is a closed frosted-glass door leading west. There is an exit to the east. Don't worry, there is no door. There is an exit to the north.

There is a knife, an orange bell pepper and a raw red potato on the floor.
